question: upgrade shipped TG1x-hyst2 x VB(10,100,5) 1x book to higher leverage?

harness.meaning: shipped_A1_VB_qr_parity through this harness reproduces bt_verdict.json e_bootstrap medians bit-for-bit -> harness and design are identical to the shipped 1x bootstrap.

limitation: bootstrap resamples close-to-close daily net returns; intraday (5m mark) liquidation paths are outside its geometry. Analyst's 5m sims: no kills <=2x on the realized path, but deep bootstrap resamples at >=2x approach LP distances where intraday kills become plausible (2x LP ~50% adverse from a pyramided EP).

a_is_the_uplift_real.reading: CAGR uplift is economically large but statistically UNRESOLVED (~82% of resamples positive at 1.5x, p=0.18; ~76% at 2x, p=0.25). MDD worsening is statistically CERTAIN: p(dMDD<=0)=1.0000 at every rung - all 2000 paired resamples draw down deeper under leverage.

b_risk_adjusted_truth.reading: Leverage scales return AND risk symmetrically: realized Sharpe is flat (0.917-0.918 at 1x/1.5x/2x; dSharpe median ~0, p~0.5) and DEGRADES at 3x (0.903) as churn convexity bites. Calmar deteriorates monotonically 0.79 -> 0.75 -> 0.69 -> 0.49. Raw CAGR peaks at 2x (51.6% > 3x 44.9%) while risk-adjusted performance peaks at 1x. Leverage buys raw CAGR only.

c_selection_bias.reading: Even the BEST of the 9 scanned variants fails the naive resampling test (p=0.084) and dies under Bonferroni (0.75)/Holm (0.68). The Romano-Wolf max-statistic says the family's best improvement exceeds what selection alone produces (p=0.010; E[max|null]=+1.3pp vs +9.8pp realized) - so a real but modest MDD effect exists (+6.3pp boot median, CI95 [-2.1,+15.7] crosses 0). The pre-registered rv60 arm (bias-free): +4.7pp median, p=0.077 FULL / 0.104 OOS - NOT significant, costs -6.3pp/yr CAGR. No conditional rule delivers a mandate-rescuing MDD after correction.

frozen_definition.deadband: +/-5% of 1.5x target (shipped mechanic extended to L)

if_user_raises_tolerance_to_60pct.expected: FULL CAGR 44.8% (vs 33.7%), realized MDD -59.5%, boot MDD median -65.2% CI95 worst -90.0%, P(MDD<-50%)=0.89; dCAGR +11.0pp p=0.18; Sharpe unchanged 0.917; Calmar 0.75 (vs 0.79)
if_user_raises_tolerance_to_60pct.requires: risk-manager amends the 1x hard cap (risk_checks.json) AND user raises MDD tolerance to >=60% (>=66% to cover the bootstrap median)

conditional_path.if_tolerance_55pct: strategist_1.5_rv60 (spec section 8, pre-registered) is the only arm with realized MDD (-54.7%) near the band, but its bootstrap median -60.7% still breaches 55%; offer only with the statistical caveat attached

e_recommendation.stay_at_1x_if: mandate stays 40-50%. Shipped book: realized -42.5%, boot median -49.4%, P(breach 50%)=0.48 - the current mandate already tolerates a coin-flip breach probability at 1x
e_recommendation.killed: 3x (realized -92.3%, economic near-ruin, CAGR<2x => dominated), 5x/10x (liquidated on realized path per analyst 5m sims)
e_recommendation.bottom_line: 1.5x improves CAGR but NO arm fits the 40-50% mandate. The uplift is directionally likely (p=0.18) but not statistically proven; the MDD cost is certain (p=1.0). User must raise tolerance to ~60% (1.5x constant) or stay at 1x. There is no statistically honest path to 2x+.

risk_manager_handoff_flags: MDD worsening under leverage is statistically certain (p=1.0000, all 2000 resamples) - this is a deterministic scaling fact, not a risk estimate.
CAGR uplift at 1.5x: 82% of resamples positive, p=0.18 - same 'economically large, statistically unresolved' signature as the VB overlay itself (bt_verdict flag 2).

Bootstrap is close-to-close; intraday liquidation channel priced separately by analyst (no kills <=2x realized). At 2x, boot CI95 worst -96.4% approaches pyramided-EP LP distances; if 2x is ever reconsidered, a 5m-path bootstrap is mandatory first.

Funding regime scaling: 2021-style in-market funding 35%/yr at 1x becomes 52.5%/yr at 1.5x, 70%/yr at 2x (analyst drag table, L-linear). risk_checks.json stress_A (25%/yr in-market) cut OOS CAGR 20.4%->11.1% at 1x; the same stress at 1.5x would compress it toward ~9% (linear extrapolation, not re-simulated).
Even at shipped 1x, 48% of bootstrap resamples breach the -50% ceiling (book accounting; 42% on QR-parity series). The mandate band itself sits at the edge of the 1x envelope.
Conditional rules add threshold knife-edge toggles (analyst forensics eps 11/12: survival was threshold luck) for a non-significant +4.7pp MDD median benefit at -6.3pp/yr CAGR cost.
